name: Picard Facepalm
look: Captain Jean-Luc Picard, played by Patrick Stewart, sits in his beige captain's chair on the starship bridge in a red and black Starfleet uniform. He buries his face in his right hand in a weary facepalm.
use: The go-to reaction to something so dumb or obvious it hurts. The caption describes a foolish mistake, a pointless question or an embarrassing situation, and Picard buries his face in his hand.
examples: Locked my keys in the car
describe: star trek captain covering his face with his hand
bald man in a red uniform doing a facepalm
patrick stewart holding his head in his hand
starship captain hiding his face in embarrassment
man in a captain's chair with his hand over his face in disbelief
origin: From the Star Trek: The Next Generation episode "Deja Q," with Patrick Stewart as Captain Jean-Luc Picard.
